Triage.text:
TECH SPECS
Triage

Triage is an AI-powered inbox for teams to manage unplanned work such as incoming bug reports and feature requests. When an issue is created by an integration or by a user not belonging to a specific Linear team, it will appear here. Triage offers an opportunity to review, update, and prioritize issues before they are added to the team’s workflow.

TRIAGE INTELLIGENCE
Triage intelligence

Triage Intelligence automates issue triage by analyzing new issues as they enter Triage and generating suggested properties (such as teams, projects, assignees, and labels) and relationships (related issues and duplicates). Suggestions can be reviewed manually or configured to auto-apply.

Triage responsibility

Triage responsibility defines who triages new issues for a team during a given time window. It supports notifying specific members, automatically assigning incoming issues, and integrating with on-call schedule providers to
automate rotations.

Cloud Coding Agent.text:
TECH SPECS
Coding sessions

Coding sessions let you run agentic coding workflows in Linear. When you delegate an issue to Linear, we start a secure coding session through Claude Code or Codex. Linear opens a draft pull request and returns the diff for review.

LINEAR AGENT
How coding sessions work

Start: Delegate an issue, prompt Linear Agent, mention @linear in Slack or Teams, or trigger a session automatically from a loop.

Implement: Linear gathers context from your workspace and repository, prepares a secure cloud environment, and implements the change.

Verify: Linear runs tests, launches local applications, and can capture screenshots or recordings to verify its work.

Review: Inspect the diff, steer the session, request revisions, and merge the pull request directly from Linear.
